questions.question_text: Why is it important to include buffer time in a daily schedule?

options.text: To make the schedule look more professional
To account for unexpected delays or tasks taking longer than planned
To fill gaps with extra study sessions
To ensure every minute of the day is planned

questions.question_text: What is a key advantage of using digital apps like Google Calendar over paper planners?

options.text: They are more visually appealing with stickers and colors
They allow for tactile writing which improves memory
They can sync across devices and send reminders for deadlines
They are less distracting than paper planners

questions.question_text: According to the chapter, what is the primary goal of balancing study and relaxation?

options.text: To spend equal time on both activities every day
To achieve a sustainable rhythm where work is effective and rest is refreshing
To eliminate all stress from academic responsibilities
To maximize study time by minimizing relaxation

questions.question_text: When building a weekly schedule, what should students do to manage larger tasks effectively?

options.text: Complete the entire task in one day to get it over with
Break the task into smaller chunks and assign them to specific days
Ignore the task until the deadline approaches
Delegate the task to someone else to save time

questions.question_text: What is a recommended strategy to avoid procrastination during scheduled relaxation time?

options.text: Skip relaxation time altogether to focus on studying
Set a timer to limit relaxation and return to the schedule afterward
Allow relaxation to extend as long as desired to fully unwind
Replace relaxation with additional academic tasks

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a benefit of using a paper planner over a digital app?

options.text: It provides automatic reminders for upcoming tasks
It syncs across multiple devices for easy access
It offers a distraction-free way to organize tasks without notifications
It allows for quick searching of past entries
